source.notes: ICSE Class VIII school quarterly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Quarterly Examination 2018-2019', 'Phy.', 'Class : VIII', 'Time : 2 hrs.', 'Full Marks : 80'; examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). The PDF is a booklet imposition: 4 scanned sheets each holding two printed pages (PDF p1 = printed p1; p2 = printed 2 and 7; p3 = printed 6 and 3; p4 = printed 4 and 5); the `page` field gives the PDF page. No text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Section A (40 marks, Q1-Q4, attempt all); Section B (40 marks, 'Attempt any four questions') prints Q5, Q6, a second Q6 (recorded as Q7), Q8, Q9 and Q10. Some sub-parts print no marks (recorded as 0 and flagged). Motion and gravity items are mapped to force-and-pressure as the nearest listed chapter. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
